description: This is a C# source file defining the 'ExtensionManager' class, which manages extensions and features within the OrchardCore framework. It handles loading, dependency resolution, and ordering of features and extensions.

classes.name: ExtensionManager
classes.description: Manages extensions and features, handles initialization, dependency resolution, and ordering within OrchardCore.

methods.name: GetExtension
methods.description: Retrieves extension info by ID, ensuring initialization.

methods.name: GetFeatures (overload with featureIdsToLoad)
methods.description: Returns features matching specified IDs and their dependencies.

methods.name: LoadExtensionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously loads an extension entry by extension info.

methods.name: LoadFeaturesAsync
methods.description: Loads all features ordered by dependencies.

methods.name: LoadFeaturesAsync (with featureIdsToLoad)
methods.description: Loads specified features ordered by dependencies.

methods.name: GetFeatureDependencies
methods.description: Gets all dependencies for a given feature.

methods.name: GetDependentFeatures
methods.description: Gets all features dependent on a given feature.

methods.name: EnsureInitialized
methods.description: Initializes the extension manager, loads extensions, features, and dependencies.
